name: dev-acceptance-polarity
description: The acceptance-evidence gate (implement.md 10.1) on the implementation path. The story's `Done when` requires recovery, while its own cited spec section says a signed-out device stays locked and recovery is not wired, and the seeded source destroys the record on sign-out. The story must stay `pending` with the contradiction reported — inverting the test, rewriting the AC's meaning, or calling the opposing behaviour intentional is the incident.
